label: ACCEPT
reason: Email classes extending BaseEmail are named *Email (TeamInviteEmail, and even oauth-client-approved-notification.ts names its class OAuthClientApprovedEmail); the four outliers are ordinary BaseEmail subclasses that could follow the scheme as easily but are named *Notification/*Verification, a naming choice drift. No biome naming rule enforces it.

label: WRONG
reason: All three outliers are admin queries that take no input at all (admin/_router.ts getSMSLockStateTeamsUsers, watchlist pendingReportsCount, users list read only ctx), so there is nothing to validate (R3: legit). No-input procedures are a recurring category (e.g. stripeCustomer, unlinkConnectedAccount in loggedInViewer/_router.tsx, outOfOfficeReasonList in ooo/_router.tsx), so new ones would be false alarms.

label: ACCEPT
reason: Five of seven outliers are zod schemas named off the Z*Schema scheme (ZAdminRemoveTwoFactor, ZOutOfOfficeDelete, the misspelled ZListTeamAvailaiblityScheme, updateUserMetadataAllowedKeys) while members like ZOutOfOfficeEntriesListSchema and ZGetInputSchema follow it; only statusToEnumMap and VALID_REMINDER_MINUTES are non-schema constants (legit). 5/7 is a majority; hesitated with WRONG mixed_group because constants in schema files would be flagged.

label: ACCEPT
reason: No counted outliers (BaseEmail itself is the definition). BaseEmail.sendEmail carries the email kill switch, test-mode capture, faux-SMS skip and display-name sanitization, so a new email class that bypasses it is worth flagging. The service helpers type sendEmail(prepare: () => BaseEmail) and BaseEmail's protected members would make tsc reject a non-derived class there, but direct instantiation (BookingAttendeesRemoveService.ts) bypasses that, so hesitated between ACCEPT and TRIVIAL types.

label: WRONG
reason: ApiTags only groups endpoints in Swagger; every outlier is excluded from the docs (oauth-flow authorize/exchange carry @DocsExcludeEndpoint, SlotsController_2024_04_15 has @DocsExcludeController(true)), so a tag would do nothing. Docs-excluded endpoints are a recurring category and new ones would get false alarms; members like api-keys and slots-2024-09-04 tag at class level (R4).
